2608.12239.title: HAMP-LIC: Hessian-Aware Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Learned Image Compression
2608.12239.paper_summary: Use this plain-text version for the arXiv abstract field: Learned image compression (LIC) models achieve strong rate-distortion performance but are hindered by high computational complexity and encoding-decoding mismatches across heterogeneous hardware platforms. Uniform fixed-precision quantization alleviates these issues but suffers severe quality degradation at low bit widths because it ignores differences in the quantization sensitivities of individual layers. To enable efficient and accurate low-bit deployment of pretrained LIC models, we propose HAMP-LIC, a Hessian-aware mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) framework with a four-stage optimization strategy. First, block-wise sensitivity is estimated from the Hessian trace to capture second-order importance. Second, a task-aware refinement module adjusts these sensitivities by jointly considering quantization distortion and rate-distortion performance. Third, guided by the refined sensitivity profile, bit widths are allocated under a global model-size constraint to balance efficiency and reconstruction quality. Finally, block-wise reconstruction using a small calibration set further suppresses quantization error. Experiments on representative LIC models, including Minnen2018 and Cheng2020, demonstrate that HAMP-LIC achieves up to 4.85x model compression with as little as 0.59% BD-rate loss. It consistently outperforms existing fixed- and mixed-precision PTQ methods across multiple datasets while completely eliminating cross-platform encoding-decoding errors.
2608.12239.paper_summary_zh: 使用此純文本版本作為 arXiv 摘要欄位：學習圖像壓縮（LIC）模型在速率失真性能方面表現出色，但受到高計算複雜度和異構硬體平台之間編碼-解碼不匹配的限制。均勻固定精度量化緩解了這些問題，但在低位寬下會遭受嚴重的質量降級，因為它忽略了各個層的量化靈敏度差異。為了實現預訓練 LIC 模型的高效且準確的低位部署，我們提出了 HAMP-LIC，一個具有四階段優化策略的海森堡感知混合精度後訓練量化（PTQ）框架。首先，從海森堡跡中估計區塊級靈敏度，以捕捉二階重要性。其次，任務感知的精煉模塊通過共同考慮量化失真和速率失真性能來調整這些靈敏度。第三，在全局模型大小約束下，根據精煉的靈敏度配置位寬，以平衡效率和重建質量。最後，使用小型校準集進行區塊級重建進一步抑制量化誤差。在代表性的 LIC 模型上進行的實驗，包括 Minnen2018 和 Cheng2020，顯示 HAMP-LIC 實現了高達 4.85 倍的模型壓縮，並且僅損失 0.59% 的 BD-rate。它在多個數據集上持續超越現有的固定和混合精度 PTQ 方法，同時完全消除了跨平台的編碼-解碼錯誤。
